top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the discovery chain for GLP-1 (Holst on human secretion and insulinotropic action, Drucker on receptor biology and the proglucagon-peptide axis, Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active truncated peptide), which is mature and confirmed by large independent outcome trials. Its citation is physiology-led and states the therapeutic consequence without crediting a product. Mojsov's priority is contested and cannot be verified from the supplied material, so the wording must stay exact. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a coherent translational alternative but leaves the identity of the active form uncredited, so it ranks second. No award ranks last given the strength and maturity of the achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for the GLP-1 proposals; the profile lists no documented collaboration with the credited names. Co-authorship with Rickard Sandberg and the spatial-transcriptomics paper are unrelated to this slate.
